onboardingCreateModeBody: Eyi ni ọna deede fun awọn olumulo titun.Layergram yoo ṣe agbejade bọtini ikọkọ tuntun ati idanimọ ara ilu fun ọ.
onboardingRestoreModeTitle: Mu pada nikan ti o ba ti ni gbolohun imularada tẹlẹ.
onboardingRestoreModeBody: Lo eyi nigbati o ṣẹda idanimọ Layergram tẹlẹ ati pe o fẹ mu idanimọ kanna wa sori ẹrọ yii.
onboardingCreateHelper: Yan orukọ awọn olubasọrọ yoo rii nigbati o pin idanimọ gbogbo eniyan rẹ.O le yipada nigbamii.
onboardingRestoreHelper: Tẹ awọn olubasọrọ orukọ sii yẹ ki o rii, lẹhinna lẹẹmọ gbolohun imularada lati idanimọ ti o ṣẹda tẹlẹ.

recoveryPhraseDialogPrivacyNote: Maṣe fi gbolohun yii pamọ si awọn sikirinisoti, awọn akọsilẹ, awọn faili, tabi awọn awakọ awọsanma.Awọn olubasọrọ nikan nilo ọna asopọ idanimọ gbogbo eniyan tabi QR lẹhin iṣeto.

confirmWordBody: Lati rii daju pe a daakọ gbolohun ọrọ naa daradara, Layergram beere fun ọrọ kan lati ọdọ rẹ.

shareAndroidWhatsAppWarning: Ti ifiranṣẹ ba dabi ẹni ti a ge ni WhatsApp, lo "Daakọ" ki o fi ara rẹ jẹ.

shareAndroidWhatsAppDialogContent: WhatsApp n gé ìforígbarílẹ̀ kúrò nínú ìpín ìròyìn. Ṣí WhatsApp ki o fi ifiranṣẹ síi pẹlọwọ́ láti fi ránṣẹ́ kíkún.
shareAndroidTelegramDialogContent: Telegram ń ṣàyẹ̀wò àwọn ìàmì ìwọ̀n odo, tó ń yọkúrò nínú àwọn ìfiránsẹ́ tí wọ́n fipamọ́ Layergram. Kì í ṣe ìmọrán láti pín nípasẹ̀ àwọn àpò yìí.
security.fs.warning.recoverability: Ti o ba padanu iwọle si ẹrọ yii, awọn ifiranṣẹ to ni aabo nipasẹ Aṣiri Siwaju ko le gba pada.
security.fs.warning.device_bound: Aṣiri Iwaju ti o pọju ṣe asopọ ibaraẹnisọrọ yii si ẹrọ rẹ lọwọlọwọ. Awọn ẹrọ iyipada yoo nilo tun-idasile igba.
security.fs.warning.pending_activation: Igbesoke Aṣiri Siwaju wa ni isunmọtosi. Fi ifiranṣẹ ranṣẹ lati pari ọwọ ọwọ.
security.fs.warning.fallback_allowed: Awon ifiranse Aṣiri Siwaju n lo ratchet nikan. Wọn ko ni pidan pelu bọtini idanimo atijo.
security.fs.warning.no_silent_downgrade: Aṣiri Iwaju ti o pọju n ṣiṣẹ. Awọn ifiranṣẹ ko ṣee firanṣẹ laisi ikanni to ni aabo ti a fọwọsi.
security.fs.new_device_detected: Ẹrọ tuntun tabi igba ti a rii fun olubasọrọ yii. Igba tuntun ti o ni aabo ti wa ni idunadura.
security.fs.message_lost: Ifiranṣẹ yii jẹ fifi ẹnọ kọ nkan pẹlu igba iṣaaju ati pe ko le ṣe idinku.
security.message_not_for_me: Ko si ifiranse Layergram ti o le yipada.
security.fs.session_reset_done: Atunto igba to ni aabo. Igba titun kan yoo ṣe idunadura laifọwọyi.
security.fs.error.session_broken: Igba to ni aabo yii ti bajẹ ko si le ṣee lo.
security.fs.error.device_repair_required: Aṣiri Iwaju to pọju nbeere atunṣe ẹrọ ṣaaju fifiranṣẹ.
security.fs.error.unexpected_device: Awari ẹrọ airotẹlẹ. Ṣe atunṣe igba to ni aabo ṣaaju fifiranṣẹ.
security.fs.error.sending_blocked: Aṣiri Iwaju ti o pọju ṣe idilọwọ fifiranṣẹ ni ipo lọwọlọwọ.
security.fs.info.title: Aabo pẹlu olubasọrọ yii
security.fs.info.legacy_description: Awọn ifiranṣẹ ti wa ni ìpàrokò opin-si-opin. Aṣiri Siwaju yoo muu ṣiṣẹ laifọwọyi bi o ṣe paarọ awọn ifiranṣẹ.
security.fs.info.active_description: Aṣiri Siwaju nṣiṣẹ. Ifiranṣẹ kọọkan nlo bọtini alailẹgbẹ kan ti o jade lati ọwọ ọwọ ephemeral.
security.fs.info.active_advantage: Awọn ifiranṣẹ ti o ti kọja wa ni aabo paapaa ti awọn bọtini rẹ ba jẹ ipalara nigbamii.
security.fs.info.strict_description: Aṣiri Iwaju ti o pọju ti nṣiṣe lọwọ ati ni asopọ si ẹrọ yii. Awọn ifiranṣẹ le ṣee firanṣẹ ati gba nipasẹ ikanni to ni aabo ti a fọwọsi.
security.fs.info.broken_description: Ikanni to ni aabo ko le rii daju. Ko si awọn ifiranṣẹ ti a firanṣẹ tabi gba ni ipinlẹ yii.
security.fs.info.upgrading_description: Aṣiri Iwaju ti n ṣe igbegasoke laifọwọyi. Tẹsiwaju paarọ awọn ifiranṣẹ lati pari igba to ni aabo.
security.fs.maximum.confirm_title: Mu Aṣiri Iwaju O pọju ṣiṣẹ bi?
security.fs.maximum.confirm_body: Eyi yoo so ibaraẹnisọrọ pọ mọ ẹrọ rẹ lọwọlọwọ. Iwọ yoo nilo lati tun ilana yii ṣe ti o ba yipada awọn ẹrọ.
security.fs.maximum.pending_notice: Nduro fun {contact} lati jẹrisi Aṣiri Iwaju O pọju.
security.fs.info.legacy_advantages: Ibamu to pọ julọ pẹlu gbogbo awọn ẹrọ rẹ. Ṣiṣẹ kọja awọn ẹrọ pupọ ni nigbakannaa. Siwaju Aṣiri iṣagbega laifọwọyi nigbati atilẹyin.
security.fs.info.legacy_keep_in_mind: Awọn ifiranšẹ wọnyi ko tii ni aabo nipasẹ Aṣiri Siwaju. Igbesoke ṣẹlẹ laifọwọyi bi o ṣe paarọ awọn ifiranṣẹ.
security.fs.info.upgrading_advantages: Ṣe ilọsiwaju aabo laifọwọyi. Ṣe itọju ibaramu kọja gbogbo awọn ẹrọ rẹ.
security.fs.info.upgrading_keep_in_mind: Aṣiri Siwaju kan nikan lẹhin igbati o ti fi idi igba to ni aabo mulẹ. Eyi n ṣẹlẹ laifọwọyi nipasẹ paarọ awọn ifiranṣẹ.
security.fs.info.active_keep_in_mind: Ti olubasọrọ yii ba yipada ẹrọ tabi tun fi Layergram sori ẹrọ, igba aabo tuntun le nilo.
security.fs.info.strict_advantages: Aabo to lagbara julọ fun olubasọrọ yii. Idilọwọ ipalọlọ ipalọlọ fun awọn ifiranṣẹ olumulo.
security.fs.info.strict_keep_in_mind: Ti eniyan kan ba yipada ẹrọ, tun fi Layergram sori ẹrọ, tabi padanu ipo igba, fifiranṣẹ le da duro titi ti igba yoo fi tunse. Diẹ ninu awọn ifiranṣẹ atijọ le ma ṣe gba pada.
security.fs.info.strict_requested_descri: O beere Aṣiri Iwaju O pọju fun olubasọrọ yii. Ko ṣiṣẹ sibẹsibẹ - Layergram n duro de igba aabo ti a fọwọsi.
security.fs.info.strict_requested_advant: Ṣetan olubasọrọ yii fun ipo asopọ ẹrọ ti o lagbara julọ.
security.fs.info.strict_requested_keep_i: Iwọ ati olubasọrọ yii yẹ ki o gba lati lo ẹrọ(awọn) ti a reti. Awọn ifiranṣẹ le ma ṣee ka lati awọn ẹrọ miiran titi di igba titun ti o ni aabo yoo fi idi mulẹ.
security.fs.info.broken_keep_in_mind: Tunṣe tabi tun-fi idi igba to ni aabo ṣaaju fifiranṣẹ.
security.fs.info.suspended_description: Igba Ipamọ Siwaju ti tẹlẹ ko le ṣee lo lọwọlọwọ. Layergram le tun idunadura gbiyanju.
security.fs.info.suspended_keep_in_mind: Fi ifiranṣẹ ranṣẹ lati ṣe okunfa igbesoke igba to ni aabo tuntun.
security.fs.progress.one_more_exchange: Paṣipaarọ ifiranṣẹ kan diẹ sii lati muu ṣiṣẹ
security.fs.progress.exchanges_remaining: Nipa {n} awọn paṣipaarọ ifiranṣẹ lati mu ṣiṣẹ
security.fs.warning.recoverability_title: Diẹ ninu awọn ifiranṣẹ le ma ṣee ka nigbamii
security.fs.warning.recoverability_body: Ipo yii mu aabo dara si nipa idinku bii awọn bọtini atijọ tabi itan-itan kika ṣe wa. Ti o ba pa awọn ifiranṣẹ rẹ, tun awọn akoko tunto, tun fi Layergram sori ẹrọ, tabi nu ibi ipamọ ti paroko, diẹ ninu awọn ifiranṣẹ agbalagba le ma ṣe gba pada paapaa ti o ba tun ni ọrọ igbaniwọle to pe.
security.fs.warning.recoverability_confi: Mo ye wipe diẹ ninu awọn atijọ awọn ifiranṣẹ le di unrecoverable.
security.fs.warning.device_bound_title: Ipo yii jẹ owun si awọn ẹrọ ti a rii daju
security.fs.warning.device_bound_body: Lo nikan ti iwọ ati olubasọrọ yii ba gba lati lo ẹrọ(awọn) ti a reti. Ti enikan ba yi ẹrọ pada, tun fi Layergram sori ẹrọ, tun awọn akoko tunto, tabi lo ẹya ti o ti dagba, awọn ifiranṣẹ le ma ṣee ka titi igba aabo tuntun yoo fi fi idi mulẹ.
security.fs.warning.device_bound_confirm: Mo ti gba eyi pẹlu olubasọrọ ati loye pe ipo yii jẹ asopọ-ẹrọ.
security.fs.warning.pending_body: FS ti o pọju ko ṣiṣẹ sibẹsibẹ. Layergram n duro de igba to ni aabo ti a fọwọsi. Titi di idaniloju, olubasọrọ yii ko tii lo Aṣiri Iwaju to pọju.
security.fs.warning.fallback_body: Fallback FS atijo ti wa ni pipa. Ti ifiranse atijo ba ni ohun elo fallback, Layergram kii yoo lo laisi igba FS to ba mu.
security.fs.card.title: Aabo fun yi o tọ
security.fs.card.no_sessions: Ko si awọn akoko ti nṣiṣe lọwọ pẹlu olubasọrọ yii.
security.fs.card.explanation_prefix: Aṣiri Dari ṣiṣẹ laifọwọyi bi o ṣe paarọ awọn ifiranṣẹ. O ṣe aabo awọn ifiranṣẹ ti a firanṣẹ nikan lẹhin igba to ni aabo ti iṣeto. Awọn ifiranṣẹ ti a firanṣẹ ṣaaju iṣagbega yii wa ni aabo nipasẹ awoṣe fifi ẹnọ kọ nkan Layergram iṣaaju.
security.passphrase.settings_visible_not: Awọn eto wọnyi wa nikan nigbati ọrọ igbaniwọle rẹ ba ṣiṣẹ.
security.fs.mode.sheet_subtitle: Yan ipele Aṣiri Siwaju fun olubasọrọ yii.
security.fs.mode.advanced_desc: Aṣiri Siwaju laifọwọyi nigbati o ba ni atilẹyin. Ko si fallback akoonu atijo.
security.fs.mode.strict_desc: Idaabobo to lagbara julọ. Ohun elo, ko si ipadasẹhin.
security.contact.state.no_sessions: Ko si awọn akoko ti nṣiṣe lọwọ
security.fs.cls.legacy.desc: Ifiranṣẹ yii nlo fifi ẹnọ kọ nkan idanimọ Layergram boṣewa. Aṣiri iwaju ko ṣiṣẹ.
security.fs.cls.pre_fs.desc: Ifiranṣẹ yii jẹ fifiranṣẹ ṣaaju iṣeto Aṣiri Siwaju ati pe ko ni aabo nipasẹ FS.
security.fs.cls.negotiation.desc: Ifiranṣẹ yii jẹ apakan ti idunadura imufọwọwọ Aṣiri Siwaju.
security.fs.cls.fs_fallback.desc: Ifiranse atijo yii ni ohun elo fallback atijo ati kii se Aṣiri Siwaju pipe.
security.fs.cls.fs_only.desc: Ifiranṣẹ yii jẹ aabo nipasẹ Aṣiri Siwaju nikan. O ko le ṣe idinku pẹlu bọtini pataki.
security.fs.cls.strict: Iye ti o ga julọ ti FS
security.fs.cls.strict.desc: Ifiranṣẹ yii jẹ aabo nipasẹ Aṣiri Iwaju to pọju. Ipadabọ Legacy jẹ alaabo.
security.fs.cls.failed.desc: Ipinnu Aṣiri Siwaju kuna. Igba naa le ti tunto tabi ẹrọ yi pada.
security.fs.cls.unknown.desc: A ko le pinnu ipin aabo ti ifiranṣẹ yii.
security.pp.section_subtitle: Awọn eto ni pato si idanimọ ti a ti jade gbolohun ọrọ-iwọle.
security.pp.timeout_subtitle: Yan akoko asiko kukuru fun aabo to lagbara.
security.pp.screen_lock_subtitle: Pa awọn bọtini ọrọ igbaniwọle run lẹsẹkẹsẹ nigbati iboju ba wa ni titiipa.
security.warn.active_passphrase: Lakoko ti idanimọ yii wa ni ṣiṣi silẹ, awọn bọtini rẹ wa ninu iranti ẹrọ. Layergram ko ni aabo lodi si ijagba tabi fi ẹnuko lakoko ti idanimọ naa wa ni ṣiṣi silẹ.
security.warn.passphrase_fs: Ọrọ igbaniwọle mu idamo yii pada. O le ma mu pada atijọ Siwaju Awọn ifiranṣẹ Aabo ti ipo igba ti a beere ti paarẹ tabi ti pari.
security.warn.volatile_history: Yi mode ti a ṣe lati din ojo iwaju recoverability. Awọn ifiranṣẹ atijọ le ma ṣee ka lẹẹkansi, paapaa pẹlu ọrọ igbaniwọle to pe.
security.warn.ephemeral_session: FS ipinle ati itan jẹ Ramu-nikan. FS tun bẹrẹ lẹhin gbogbo imukuro ọrọ igbaniwọle. Ko si awọn ifiranṣẹ tabi ipo igba yoo ye.
security.warn.recoverability_body: Ipo yii mu aabo dara si nipa idinku bii awọn bọtini atijọ tabi itan-itan kika ṣe wa. Ti o ba pa awọn ifiranṣẹ rẹ, tun awọn akoko tunto, yọ idanimọ yii kuro, tun fi Layergram sori ẹrọ, padanu ipo agbegbe, tabi nu ibi ipamọ ti paroko, diẹ ninu awọn ifiranṣẹ agbalagba le ma ṣe pada paapaa ti o ba tun ni ọrọ atilẹba Layergram tabi ọrọ igbaniwọle to pe.
security.warn.recoverability_confirm: Mo ye wipe diẹ ninu awọn atijọ awọn ifiranṣẹ le di unrecoverable.
security.cleanup.title: Nu undecryptable data
security.cleanup.subtitle: Yọ data to ku kuro ti ko le ṣe idinku.
security.cleanup.dialog_body: Eyi le pa awọn ile-ipamọ ifipamọ atijọ rẹ patapata, data idanimọ ti a fi silẹ, awọn igbasilẹ ti a ti jade ni gbolohun ọrọ igbaniwọle, awọn akoko aabo, ati awọn data miiran ti Layergram ko le sọ dicrypt lọwọlọwọ.
security.cleanup.confirm_checkbox: Mo loye pe iṣe yii ko le yipada.
identityQrActionHint: Fọwọ ba tabi tẹ QR gun lati pin tabi fi pamọ bi aworan.
identityQrActionsSubtitle: Aworan yii ni idanimọ ara ilu nikan ninu.Lo iwe eto lati fipamọ si Awọn fọto tabi Awọn faili, tabi firanṣẹ.
